LanguageData.LP_Loxodon.label: loxodon
LanguageData.LP_Loxodon.description: A tall race with elephant heads and trunks, thick grey skin and a temperament as steady as a boulder. Loxodons are strong and carry a lot; the trunk works like a third hand, so they can keep working with it when both hands are hurt; they barely know what fear is. The price is walking slowly and poor shooting. The bloodline is passed on to children.
LanguageData.LP_Loxodon.descriptionShort: Inheritable burly race. Body size ×1.3, about 1.5× carrying, trunk keeps a floor on manipulation, immune to fear, thick skin; slow, poor shooting.
